name: Gouache harbour
one_line: A flat painted fishing village on a sea-green bay.
look_words: A small fishing village painted in flat gouache, like a children's book. The sea is an even sea green and takes up most of the picture; houses are warm orange wood on stilts, joined by plank walkways, with boats, barrels and crates floating between them. Paint is opaque and flat with a few visible brush strokes and a slight paper texture; shadows are a darker tone of the same colour with a soft edge. Morning light, mild and warm. Cream and buoy pink mark what to collect and the goal, a deep crimson is harm, and the player wears a bright yellow coat. Motion is bobbing: boats rock, water rings spread, gulls circle. Avoid realistic water, gloss, strong shadows, dark scenes and bloom.

palette.name: gouache harbour
palette.notes: The main "ground" is the sea. Houses are orange wood, so harm is a deep crimson that sits well away from it.

look_wish: flat gouache paint with soft-edged shadows

upgrade.why: its gouache style paints an ordinary scene with brush-sized strokes
water that rings and ripples when things touch it

sound_feel: water lapping, gulls, wooden knocks, rope creaks
